Section 2.content: Built on a solid technical foundation, IMPC provides a comprehensive service ecosystem from construction to operations. We accompany our clients throughout the entire project lifecycle, ensuring superior quality and long-term asset value.

Section 3.title: Development History
Section 3.content_2016: Established with a mission to create sustainable value, IMPC aims to become the leading provider of comprehensive solutions for Industrial Real Estate.
Section 3.content_2017: Focus on building a team of experts and management systems, creating a solid foundation for a breakthrough strategy in scale and service quality
Section 3.content_2018: Focus on building a team of experts and management systems, creating a solid foundation for a breakthrough strategy in scale and service quality
Section 3.content_2019: Implementing Legal, Project Management, and Supervision services across key industrial parks: Bau Bang, My Phuoc 3, VSIP Bac Ninh, and Luong Dien, strengthening our presence in North and South Vietnam.
Section 3.content_2020: The launch of Property Management services laid the foundation for a comprehensive service chain and IMPC’s pioneering status, expanding into Ho Chi Minh City’s IPs like Tan Phu Trung.
Section 3.content_2021: Launching Renovation and Repair services at Bau Bang and Binh Duong Complex, a strategic step toward a comprehensive full-lifecycle industrial real estate service model.
Section 3.content_2022: Selected as the Preferred Contractor for BW Industrial’s fire-rated partition installations in Southern Vietnam for two years, cementing IMPC’s reputation and market leadership.
Section 3.content_2023: Achieved ISO certifications (9001, 45001, 14001), establishing IMPC as a trusted partner for leading FDI firms like JD Property, Sembcorp, and Cainiao.
Section 3.content_2024: Obtained Fire Protection and Fighting Services certification, affirming our legal compliance and technical expertise while reinforcing IMPC’s commitment to quality and reliability.
Section 3.content_2025: Serving as the main contractor for major projects like CASA FLORA 4 (VSIP Nghe An) and P5 Infrastructure (QTIP Quang Tri), while achieving ISO certifications for comprehensive construction and supervision.
